name: Catcoin Bundle #7
description:
A set of ten bills, cartoonishly designed with cat imagery, usable in dimensions inhabited solely by cats. Exhibits a mild glow when touched by cat fur.

EFFECT: Recognized as valid currency in cat-only dimensions.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Upon contact with feline fur, emits a faint luminescence. Non-luminescent properties remain under all other conditions.
TASTE: N/A
PACKAGING: A stack of ten paper bills, each featuring the face of a cartoon cat in mid-pounce. Lacks any recognizable monetary symbols or denominations, aside from the words 'Catcoin Currency' printed in bold.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Finally, a currency tailored to the cat economy. Still no purrchase evidence in our reality though.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-08-10 — edition #7 of the permanent record.
